overview.title: Site overview
overview.summary: Atlas is an aggregated search and discovery platform that brings results from multiple sources together, with rankings, recommendations, community, and follows.
features: One search box covers five content categories: JAV, anime, movies, manga, and novels.
The JAV home page includes the follow feed, For You, JAV rankings, and trending actresses.
After signing in, search history, favorites, follows, notifications, and community content sync with your account.
The top-right corner lets you switch the proxy and theme/language, and open this Help Center at any time.
steps: Choose a category in the top navigation, or enter a keyword on the home page.
Sign in when you need synced data; browsing and searching also work without signing in.
Open a source from the results, view details, or favorite works you like.
Manage history, favorites, follows, and notifications from the Account Center.
caveats: Some features depend on site configuration, such as whether registration or the community is enabled. If an entry point is missing, the feature is probably turned off.
Content comes from third-party sources. Atlas only aggregates and indexes it and is not responsible for the content itself.

first-steps.title: Get started in three steps
first-steps.summary: Sign in, choose a category, and enter a keyword to complete your first search.
features: Sign up with email and sign in with a password, or use GitHub / Google sign-in.
The JAV category offers code, actress, and title search modes.
Open a source directly from the results, or enter the detail page to see magnet links and related information.
steps: Sign up or sign in. Registration requires an email verification code.
Choose a category at the top, such as JAV, anime, or movies.
Enter a keyword and press Enter. Open a source, favorite an entry, or continue to the detail page.
caveats: Registration requires email verification. If the email does not arrive, check spam first.
JAV codes usually follow the “letters-numbers” format. If a code search finds nothing, try title or actress mode.
Search has a quota. Repeated searches use it up faster.

for-you.title: “For You” on the home page
for-you.summary: “For You” picks works on the site based on your favorites and search history. It only appears on the JAV home page after you sign in.
features: Cards show the cover, code, site rank, and a recommendation reason such as same actress, same tag, same publisher, recent popular, weekly chart, or monthly chart.
Favorites are the main signal; repeated searches for the same actress or tag also count.
Supports refresh and collapse. The module may be hidden when there is not enough data or loading fails.
Clicking a card starts a search by its code.
steps: Sign in and open the JAV category home page.
Browse the cards and recommendation reasons under “For You”.
Click a card to search by code. Favorite more works to make recommendations fit you better.
Click the refresh button in the module header for a new batch.
caveats: “For You” is not shown when you are signed out.
Recommendations mix site popularity with your behavior and are not a quality rating.
The more you favorite, the closer recommendations get to your taste. Clearing favorites changes them noticeably.

jav-rankings.title: JAV rankings
jav-rankings.summary: The rankings on the JAV home page are grouped by weekly / monthly and censored / uncensored. Data syncs from JavDB and shows the update time.
features: Two periods (weekly, monthly) × two types (censored, uncensored), for four lists in total.
Shows rank, NEW or up/down markers, cover, title, and code. Click a cover to enlarge it.
Supports pagination and manual refresh.
Clicking an entry starts a search by its code.
steps: Open the JAV home page and scroll to “JAV rankings”.
Choose weekly or monthly, then censored or uncensored.
Click an entry to view the work; use the bottom pager for more.
If data is not updated yet, click refresh or wait for the next early-morning sync.
caveats: Rankings sync from third-party data, usually in the early morning. They may be briefly empty right after a sync.
Rank reflects popularity on the source site, not a rating on Atlas.
A failed ranking load does not affect normal search. Try refreshing later.

trending-actresses.title: Trending actresses
trending-actresses.summary: The trending actress list ranks actresses by a combination of ranked works and follower count.
features: Each actress shows rank, name, follower count, and number of ranked works.
The follow button in the top-right corner of each card follows or unfollows directly.
Clicking a name starts an actress search to view her works.
Supports refresh. The whole block is hidden when there is no data or loading fails.
steps: Find “Trending actresses” on the JAV home page.
Browse the ranking and click follow to subscribe to actresses you like.
Click a name to open her works in search results.
Check new and upcoming releases later under Account Center → Follow feed.
caveats: The ranking combines ranked works across all four lists with follower counts, so it changes over time.
You can follow up to 100 actresses.
The list is visible when signed out, but following requires signing in.

search-basics.title: Keywords and search modes
search-basics.summary: All categories share one search box; the JAV category adds code, actress, and title modes.
features: Keywords work with titles, codes, and actress names. Press Enter or click Search.
JAV modes: code (e.g. SONE-520), actress, and title. The input hint changes with the mode.
A suggestion dropdown appears as you type; click a suggestion to search immediately.
The current quota is shown near the search box. If it runs out, wait for the reset as prompted.
steps: Choose a category at the top.
Under JAV, choose code, actress, or title mode.
Enter a keyword and press Enter to see results.
Use filters, sorting, or pagination to adjust the results.
caveats: Codes usually follow the “letters-numbers” format. If a code search finds nothing, try title or actress mode.
When the quota is exhausted, wait for it to reset instead of repeating searches.
Suggestions and quota status follow what the page actually shows.

tabs-diff.title: How search Tabs differ
tabs-diff.summary: The top Tabs decide what kind of content you search. “Sources” is not a keyword search but a source directory, and the community is now a separate page.
features: JAV: code, actress, and title modes; results lead to details, magnets, and sources.
Anime: aggregates by work and shows subtitling group, size, and release date.
Movies: aggregates by work and shows resolution, size, and release date.
Manga: shows chapters and update status.
Novels: shows author, publisher, category, and chapters.
Sources: shows the source directory, supports health checks and opening sites, and does not run a keyword search.
steps: Choose the Tab that matches the content you want.
Switching Tabs keeps the current keyword and searches again.
To visit source sites directly, switch to “Sources”.
To browse community content, open the separate “Community” page from the top.
caveats: The community is not a search Tab. The old `?tab=community` link redirects to `/community`.
Anime and movies support aggregated and source views. Aggregated view merges the same work across sources.
Tab visibility depends on site configuration.

filters-sort.title: Filters, sorting, and pagination
filters-sort.summary: Use categories and views to filter results, then sort and paginate to control browsing order.
features: Category filter: the top Tab is the first filter. Switching re-runs the current keyword.
Source view: anime and movie results can switch between “aggregated” and “by source”.
Sorting: results follow the aggregated order by default. Community lists support “Latest / Hottest”.
Pagination: when there are many results, use the bottom pager or Previous / Next.
steps: Confirm the category and keyword first.
Switch to source view when comparing different sources.
Use sorting and pagination to adjust browsing order.
Click refresh in the results header to fetch results again.
caveats: Sorting options differ by category; some categories only offer the default order.
Aggregated view merges the same work, while source view expands every source record.
Pagination may reset after you change filters.

result-actions.title: Actions on the results page
result-actions.summary: Every result can open its source directly; after signing in you can also favorite or share to the community.
features: Open source: click “Go” or the external-link button to open the original site in a new tab.
Favorite: after signing in, click the heart to favorite; click again to remove it.
Proxy access: with the proxy enabled, sources open through the proxy and the button color changes.
Share to community: JAV detail pages and similar pages offer “Share to community”, where you can add a recommendation and tags.
steps: Find the entry you want in the results.
Open its source or enter the detail page.
After signing in, click the heart to favorite it.
To share, choose “Share to community” on the detail page.
caveats: The favorite button is unavailable when signed out.
You need to judge the content and safety risk of third-party sources yourself.
Pages may load more slowly when the proxy is enabled; this is normal.

history-favorites.title: Search history and favorites
history-favorites.summary: After signing in, the home right rail and the Account Center record search history and favorites, with bulk management.
features: Search history is grouped by Today / Yesterday / date and shows covers and basic information.
Supports selecting individual items, selecting a whole day, bulk deletion, clearing all history, and pagination.
Favorites support “Want to watch / Watched” status switching, pagination, deletion, and export.
Favorite entries can open the original source; with the proxy enabled they open through it.
The Account Center History and Favorites pages offer the same management.
steps: Sign in and run a search; history is recorded automatically.
Click an entry in the home right rail or Account Center → History to fill in the keyword again.
Click the heart on a result or detail page to favorite a work.
Use the Favorites page to switch status, export, or delete.
caveats: Search history and favorites are account data; deleting your account removes them.
History is not recorded when signed out, and the favorite button is unavailable.
Exported files contain work information, so store them safely.

jav.title: JAV category
jav.summary: Search by code, actress, or title, with details, rankings, recommendations, and a follow feed.
features: Code search: enter a code to find a work; matches show details, magnet links, and source entry points.
Actress search: enter an actress name to see her works and follow her directly.
Title search: find works by title or keyword.
Home modules: follow feed, For You, JAV rankings, and trending actresses.
Detail fields: code, release date, duration, studio, series, tags, actresses, magnet links, and more.
steps: Choose the JAV category.
Choose code, actress, or title mode and enter your input.
Open a work detail or source from the results.
Favorite, follow actresses, or share to the community on the detail page.
caveats: An invalid code format leads directly to no results.
Some works have no magnet links; the detail page explains this.
Rankings, recommendations, and the follow feed rely on third-party data or background checks and may be temporarily unavailable.

anime-movie.title: Anime and movie categories
anime-movie.summary: Anime and movie results group different sources of the same work together, and you can also view them by source.
features: Anime: view works in aggregated mode or switch to a source list; subtitling group, size, and release date are shown.
Movies: aggregated and source views are available, showing resolution, size, and release date.
Open and favorite: open a source directly from the result row, or sign in to favorite it.
steps: Choose the anime or movie category.
Enter the work title and press Enter.
View results in aggregated or source view.
Open a source or favorite an entry.
caveats: Information for the same work may differ across sources.
Source view has more entries; aggregated view is better for comparison.
Browsing works when signed out, but favoriting requires signing in.

manga-novel.title: Manga and novel categories
manga-novel.summary: Manga and novels are shown by chapter or bibliographic information, making it easy to continue reading or favorite.
features: Manga: chapters, update status, and source links.
Novels: author, publisher, category, chapters, and source links.
Favorites: sign in to favorite entries and manage them from the Account Center.
steps: Choose the manga or novel category.
Enter a title, author, or keyword.
Open a source to continue reading.
After signing in, favorite entries for later.
caveats: Chapters and update status come from third-party sources and may lag behind.
Different sources may divide chapters differently.

sources.title: Search sources
sources.summary: The “Sources” Tab shows every source site indexed by Atlas; the Account Center Sources page lets you enable, test, and manage sources.
features: Expand by major category → category → source to see the source name, site type, and enabled status.
Run a health check on a single source; results show online, restricted, timeout, offline, or error with response time.
Run a check on all sources, check one source, or open the source site externally.
The Account Center Sources page supports enabling/disabling by source, category, or major category, adding custom sources, editing or deleting custom sources, and exporting JSON / CSV / OPML.
Disabled sources are not used in later searches.
steps: Switch to “Sources” at the top of the home page to view the directory.
Expand major categories and categories to find the target source.
Click the check button for a health check, or the external-link icon to open the site.
To change which sources participate in search, use the Account Center Sources page.
caveats: Availability is controlled by third-party sites; restricted or timed-out does not necessarily mean permanently down.
Disabling sources reduces search results. When troubleshooting, confirm the source is enabled first.
Custom sources require a category and URL template; mistakes will lead to no results.

detail-page.title: Entry detail page
detail-page.summary: The detail page collects work information, magnet links, source entry points, and community sharing.
features: Basic information: release date, duration, director, studio, publisher, series, and tags.
Actresses and follows: click an actress to view her works, or follow her directly.
Magnet links: expand the magnet list to copy a link or open WebTor. A hint appears when no magnet is available.
Recommendations: other works are suggested based on the current work’s tags, actresses, and studio.
Favorite and share: favorite the current work or share it to the community.
steps: Click a code or work in JAV results, notifications, the follow feed, or a community post.
View basic information and magnet links.
Click an actress to view her works or follow her.
Favorite the current work or share it to the community.
caveats: If details fail to load, use the retry button or go back and open another source.
Recommendations are based on the current work’s attributes and do not mean similar content is available.
Sharing to the community makes your recommendation and selected tags public.

community-browse-post.title: Browse, filter, and post
community-browse-post.summary: The community is a separate page with type filters, search, sorting, and sharing from search results or detail pages.
features: Browse: search posts on the discovery page and filter by All, JAV, Anime, Movies, Manga, Novels, or Actresses.
Sorting and view: “Latest / Hottest” sorting plus grid and list views.
Posting: from a JAV detail page, click “Share to community”, add a recommendation (up to 200 characters), and choose tags.
My posts: view and manage your own posts under “My posts”.
Tags: browse popular tags and their posts on the Tags page.
steps: Open the “Community” page from the top.
Use type filters, search, and sorting to find posts.
Open a post to view details and interact.
To publish, share from a work detail page or manage posts under My posts.
caveats: Whether the community entry appears depends on the site feature flag.
The community is not a search Tab. The old `?tab=community` link redirects to `/community`.
Guests cannot post, comment, or like.

community-interact.title: Comments, likes, and favorites
community-interact.summary: After signing in you can like, favorite, and comment on posts. Comments are limited to 500 characters.
features: Like: click the heart on a post; click again to remove the like.
Favorite: save posts you like and find them under “My favorites”.
Comment: enter a comment at the bottom of a post; press Ctrl / Cmd + Enter to send quickly.
Delete comments: you can delete your own comments after a confirmation.
Share link: copy a share link from the post detail page.
steps: Sign in and open a post detail page.
Like, favorite, or comment.
View saved posts under “My favorites”.
Copy the post link when you want to share it.
caveats: Comments are public. Do not include sensitive personal information.
Deleted comments cannot be restored.
Reported or rule-breaking posts may be handled by moderators.

community-rules-report.title: Reports and community rules
community-rules-report.summary: Report inappropriate content and moderators will review it and notify you of the outcome.
features: Report entry: the report button at the top-right of a post detail page.
Reasons: inappropriate content, false information, copyright issues, spam, or other.
Details: add an explanation to help moderators review the report.
Outcome: after the report is handled, you receive an in-app or email notification depending on your settings.
steps: Open the post detail page.
Click the report button and choose a reason.
Add details and submit.
Check the notification center for the outcome.
caveats: Do not abuse reporting. Malicious reports may affect your account.
Reports take time to process, and the outcome may not match your expectation.
For copyright issues, provide verifiable information.

follow-actress.title: Follow actresses
follow-actress.summary: Follow actresses from the actress list, a work detail page, or Account Center → My follows.
features: Where to follow: the follow button in actress lists or detail pages, or add a name manually in the Account Center.
Limit: follow up to 100 actresses.
View works: click an actress name to jump to her search results.
Unfollow: remove one follow on the management page, or select several and remove them in bulk.
steps: Open the actress list or a work detail page.
Click follow to subscribe to an actress.
Review and adjust follows under Account Center → My follows.
Click an actress name to view her works.
caveats: Following requires signing in.
When adding a name manually, check the spelling or works may not match.
The follow limit is 100 actresses.

follow-feed.title: Follow feed and alerts
follow-feed.summary: The follow feed collects new releases and upcoming works, with mute and mark-as-read support.
features: Where to find it: “Follow feed” on the JAV home page and in the Account Center.
Feed types: new releases and upcoming releases.
Unread badge: shows the unread count; mark everything as read in one click.
Per-actress alerts: mute or restore alerts for an actress under “My follows”; this applies to in-app and email at once.
Bulk actions: mute, restore alerts, or unfollow several actresses at once.
steps: Follow at least one actress.
Open “Follow feed” on the JAV home page or in the Account Center.
Switch between new and upcoming releases.
Mute specific actresses when you want fewer alerts.
caveats: The follow feed relies on scheduled source checks. If a check fails, retry later.
Muting only affects alerts, not the follow relationship.
Whether a new work is available depends on the source site.

notification-center.title: Notification center
notification-center.summary: Use the top-right bell for recent notifications. The Account Center Notifications page provides the full inbox and notification settings.
features: The bell shows the unread count, loads recent notifications page by page, and supports mark-all-read.
Clicking a notification with a code opens the work by code; community notifications with a post go straight to the post detail; announcements and other notifications open the notification center.
The Notifications page has two Tabs, Inbox and Notification settings. There is no separate community notification entry.
The inbox supports unread-only, pagination, deleting individual items, and clearing read items.
steps: Click the top-right bell to view recent notifications.
Click a notification to jump to the matching place.
Open Account Center → Notifications for the full list.
Filter or delete in the inbox, and adjust channels in notification settings.
caveats: Different notifications open in different places; differing destinations are expected.
In-app and email switches are independent.
Announcement notifications usually cannot be turned off.

email-verification.title: Email verification
email-verification.summary: Verify your email before enabling email notifications. The code has 6 digits.
features: Send a 6-digit code to the current email from notification settings.
After verification, the email status becomes “Verified” and email switches become available.
The code has a countdown; you can resend after it ends.
steps: Go to Account Center → Notifications → Notification settings.
Click “Verify email” on the email card.
Enter the 6-digit code you received and submit.
After verification, enable the email notifications you need.
caveats: All email switches are unavailable until the email is verified.
If the code does not arrive, check spam and confirm the email address.
Codes expire; request a new one after expiry.

email-preferences.title: Email preferences and privacy
email-preferences.summary: Each notification type can control in-app and email channels separately, and sensitive details can be hidden from emails.
features: Types: new works from followed actresses, post likes / comments / favorites, report outcomes, and site announcements.
Channel toggles: every type has separate “In-app” and “Email” switches.
Hide email details: emails show only counts, without actress names or codes, and use a neutral subject.
Batching: new feed items are combined into one email every 30 minutes, up to 3 emails per day; extras are deferred.
Test email: after verification, send a test email to confirm delivery.
steps: Go to Account Center → Notifications → Notification settings.
Verify your email first.
Turn in-app and email channels on or off by type.
Enable “Hide email details” or send a test email when needed.
caveats: If emails do not arrive, check spam, the verification status, and the matching toggle.
Hiding details only affects the email body, not in-app notifications.
Batching delays some alerts; this is expected.

unsubscribe.title: Unsubscribe from emails
unsubscribe.summary: Every notification email has a one-click unsubscribe link; you can also turn emails off in notification settings.
features: From email: click “Unsubscribe from email notifications” at the bottom and confirm.
Email only: unsubscribing does not affect in-app notifications.
Resubscribe: turn the matching email toggle back on in notification settings.
Expired link: if the unsubscribe link is invalid, sign in and disable email notifications from the Account Center.
steps: Open any notification email.
Click the unsubscribe link at the bottom and confirm.
Sign in to notification settings to turn emails back on.
caveats: Unsubscribing does not unfollow actresses.
Some account emails, such as verification codes, are not affected by unsubscribe.
Unsubscribe links may expire.

register-login.title: Sign up and sign in
register-login.summary: Email registration, password sign-in, and GitHub / Google sign-in are supported.
features: Registration: username 3–20 characters, password 6–100 characters, email verified with a 6-digit code.
Sign in: use your username or email plus password. Use “Forgot password” on the sign-in page if needed.
Registration switch: the site may disable registration. The sign-up page will explain; existing accounts can still sign in.
Sign out: top-right user menu → Sign out.
steps: Open the sign-up page and enter a username, email, and password.
Enter the email verification code to finish registration.
Sign in with your username or email.
Use the top-right user menu to sign out.
caveats: Passwords must be 6–100 characters.
Whether email verification is required depends on site configuration, but it is usually required.
Do not share your account with others.

oauth.title: Third-party sign-in (OAuth)
oauth.summary: Sign in with GitHub or Google without remembering a separate password.
features: Entry: the GitHub / Google buttons at the bottom of the sign-in page.
First sign-in: an account is created or linked automatically and you return to the site.
Callback failure: if the callback page reports an error, return to sign-in and retry, or use password sign-in.
steps: Click GitHub or Google on the sign-in page.
Complete authorization on the third-party page.
Wait to be redirected back to the site.
The first use creates or links an account.
caveats: OAuth availability depends on whether the site has configured the provider app. If the button is missing, it is not enabled.
The security of your third-party account is handled by that platform.
Do not click repeatedly if the callback fails; retry later.

email-password.title: Change email and password
email-password.summary: Changing your email requires your current password and a code sent to the new address; changing your password signs you out.
features: Change email: Account Center → Settings → Profile → “Change” next to email.
The new email needs a 6-digit code, and you must enter your current password.
Change password: Account Center → Settings → Security → Change password.
You are signed out after the change and must sign in with the new credentials.
steps: Open the Profile section in Account Center → Settings.
Click “Change” next to email and enter the new email and current password.
Enter the code sent to the new address to finish.
To change your password, enter the current and new passwords.
caveats: Sign in with the new email after changing it.
Changing your password invalidates the current session.
The new password must be 6–100 characters.

reset-password.title: Reset your password
reset-password.summary: Reset your password with an email code; the old password is not required.
features: Click “Forgot password” on the sign-in page.
Enter your registered email and request a 6-digit code.
Enter the code and a new password to sign in.
steps: Click “Forgot password” on the sign-in page.
Enter your registered email and request a code.
Enter the code and a new password.
Sign in with the new password.
caveats: Codes expire; request a new one after expiry.
If the email does not arrive, check spam first.
Resetting your password does not lift account bans or restrictions.

delete-account.title: Delete your account
delete-account.summary: Deleting your account permanently removes its data and cannot be undone.
features: Entry: Account Center → Settings → Security → Danger zone → Delete account.
You must read the impact, enter a confirmation text, and provide an email code.
Profile, favorites, search history, custom sources, and other account data are deleted.
steps: Go to Account Center → Settings → Security.
Find the danger zone and click Delete account.
Read the impact and confirm to continue.
Enter the confirmation text and email code, then submit.
caveats: A deleted account cannot be restored.
If you only want a break, sign out instead of deleting your account.
Back up any favorites you want to keep before deleting.

general-notices.title: General notices
general-notices.summary: Before using Atlas, understand the basic rules for content sources, account security, email delivery, and data retention.
features: Content sources and disclaimer: search results, rankings, recommendations, and details come from third-party sites. Atlas only aggregates and indexes them.
Account security: use a unique password and do not share your account. Verification codes are for your own actions only.
Notifications and email: in-app notifications arrive immediately; emails may be delayed by spam filters, blocking rules, or your email provider.
Data retention: search history, favorites, follows, and notifications are stored in your account; deleting the account removes them.
steps: Check the laws and regulations where you live and your personal usage boundaries.
Set a unique password for your account and keep your email secure.
Review notification settings and email verification status regularly.
Delete data or your account from the Account Center when you need to clean up.
caveats: Follow local laws and regulations and use this site only for lawful personal information retrieval.
Third-party sites are responsible for their availability, content, and security. Judge the risk yourself before opening external links.
Never enter passwords, verification codes, or payment information into third-party sources from any page.
If emails never arrive, check spam and blocking rules first, then confirm the email is verified and the matching email toggle is on.
Site features and copy may change; the page as displayed is authoritative.

faq-search.title: No results or very few results
faq-search.summary: Work through these checks in order to find the cause quickly.
caveats: Change mode: if a JAV code finds nothing, try title or actress mode.
Change category: make sure the top Tab matches the content type you want.
Check sources: run a health check in “Sources” or Account Center → Sources, and confirm the source is online and enabled.
Wait for quota: if the quota is exhausted, wait for the reset as prompted and avoid repeated searches.
Change keywords: try a shorter keyword, an alias, or remove extra symbols.

faq-access.title: Sources will not open or fail to load
faq-access.summary: What to try when a source will not open, images are missing, or details fail to load.
caveats: Enable the proxy: try the top-right proxy toggle for restricted sources.
Try another source: the same entry may be available from several sources.
Retry: use retry when details fail; if it still fails, go back and search again.
Missing images: hotlink protection or network issues may be the cause. Refresh the page or enable the proxy.
Proxy confirmation: the first time you enable the proxy, a notice appears; it takes effect after you confirm.

faq-account.title: Account, verification code, and notification issues
faq-account.summary: Troubleshooting for sign-in problems, missing verification codes, and missing notifications.
caveats: No verification code: check spam, confirm the email address, then resend after the countdown.
Signed out unexpectedly: sign in again. If you changed your password or email, use the new credentials.
No email notifications: confirm the email is verified, the matching “Email” toggle is on, and you have not unsubscribed.
No in-app notifications: confirm the matching “In-app” toggle is on and check unread items in the notification center.
Still stuck: use the feedback button at the bottom-right of the page and include the steps you took.
